snip.s: Medical Bacteriology and Entomology MCQs — MCQ Bank

snip.t: Conventional cultures can take up to 10 weeks; liquid media radiometric assays provide results in approximately 2 weeks.
PCR amplification can be performed on liquid media or tissue sections.

qs.q: What is a primary advantage of utilizing liquid media (such as BACTEC) over solid media (such as Lowenstein-Jensen media) for tuberculosis culture?
o: Reduced need for stringent biosafety measures
Allows for more accurate drug susceptibility testing
Significantly lower cost per test performed
qs.e: Liquid culture systems like BACTEC detect Mycobacterium tuberculosis growth much faster (within 4-14 days) compared to solid media (3-6 weeks), enabling earlier diagnosis and treatment initiation. While more expensive, the speed is a critical advantage for patient management.
